people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles; and the cry is heard among the nations.
translations.bsb: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will quake; a cry will be heard among the nations.
translations.kjv: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
translations.asv: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembleth, and the cry is heard among the nations.
